title: Botocore ClientError exceptions must be explicitly caught and handled
description: This rule enforces that AWS SDK (botocore) ClientError exceptions must be explicitly caught and handled rather than using generic exception handling. Generic exception handling can mask important AWS-specific errors and make debugging more difficult. Proper handling of ClientError allows for better error recovery and more precise error reporting in AWS operations.
message: Catch and handle 'botocore.exceptions.ClientError' explicitly instead of using generic exception handling. Current implementation may mask AWS-specific errors.

compliant.description: Good: Explicitly catches ClientError and handles AWS-specific error codes.
Good: Catches ClientError and re-raises with more specific exceptions when appropriate.

noncompliant.description: Bad: Uses generic Exception catch which masks AWS-specific errors.
Bad: Bare except clause catches all exceptions including ClientError without proper handling.

noncompliant.code:
import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError

s3 = boto3.client('s3')

try:
    s3.download_file('my-bucket', 'my-key', '/tmp/my-file')
except BotoCoreError as e:
    print(f'Boto error: {e}')
noncompliant.description: Bad: Catches the parent BotoCoreError instead of the more specific ClientError.
